news_drivers.headline: What Moved Markets
news_drivers.summary: Iran tensions dominated headlines with tanker seizures and geopolitical discussions, while memory sector mania drove tech gains. UK political uncertainty and Toyota's Iran war impact warnings added to global concerns, but markets shrugged off geopolitical risks.
